# Copilot instructions

All agent instructions for this repo live in **AGENTS.md** at the repo root — follow it.
Key rules: work only in your member folder, treat `contracts/` as the source of truth for every
interface, use camelCase JSON / snake_case DB / UUID ids / ISO-8601 UTC times, and ask other members
via `questions/to-<member>/` instead of changing their code.
